title: Fundamentals of Arctic Engineering - Fall 2026
description: This course introduces students to a broad spectrum of engineering challenges that are unique to cold regions of the world. Physical principles and practical data collection, analysis, design, and construction methods are discussed. Students gain a working knowledge of cold regions engineering problems and modern solutions as a basis for more detailed study. Information in the format of narrated slide presentations, videos, and other online study aids is presented in 10 daily increments.
